text:
pranav: Heads-up — we started seeing a cluster-wide memory cliff on canaries right after yesterday's allocator packing change. Long prompts hit OOM within ~30s of steady traffic.
sasha: saw it too on 24g hosts, memes of smaps exploded.
eli: is this the alignment/reservation tweak from #4321?
pranav: yeah that one — it increased per-kv entry reservation to align payloads, supposed to reduce CPU copying.
jen: can you paste the smaps diff or top of flame?
pranav: smaps excerpt + rss delta attached (trimmed):
```
-old: Rss: 2.1G
-new: Rss: 3.4G
-mmap_count: +1200
```
pranav: flame shows cache hotpath unchanged but kernel alloc spikes on slab->mmap churn.
sasha: repro script? I can run on perf harness.
pranav: repro = run loadgen --seq-len 16k --kv-pop 80% --stay-open; we see OOM after ~1h on current canary. command: `./tools/loadgen --profile longseq --concurrency 8`
eli: ran with perf counters: allocation_count up 2.4x, page_faults up 3x. Fragmentation metric (free_segments) decreased, small free_chunks increased.
jen: CI flagged a perf regression earlier for memory P50 on longseq tests, MR #4321 touched allocator packing and kernel-routing.
pranav: bisect narrowed to commit 9f8c3b7 (allocator: pad-reserve-per-entry).
pranav: rolling back that patch locally removes the cliff and brings rss back down.
sasha: interesting — the aim was to reduce copies, but it ended up increasing residency for small entries and creating tiny mmaps instead of coalesced slabs.
jen: @oncall — should we gate the rollout? deploy-bot, status?
deploy-bot: Rollout paused: rule=memory-cliff-detection, action=hold, reason=canary-ooms (3/3 hosts)
pranav: I think we should revert in canaries and hold the global rollout. I have a candidate fix: dynamic packing that falls back to legacy layout when free_chunks > threshold.
eli: candidate sounds good. Can you add a toggle behind flag and a perf test? We need telemetry: per-entry reserved_bytes, mmap_count, fragmentation score.
sasha: I'll add a short reproducer to smoke tests and a perf CI job for long-tail sequences.
pranav: created PR with revert+feature-flag: PR #4378, includes profiling logs and mitigations.
jen: QA — add an acceptance check: run longseq for 2h on smallest canary and ensure rss < baseline + 10%.
pranav: noted. I'll run local extended repro and attach smaps once green.
eli: also add a metrics alert for mmap_count / node > 500 within 30m. That would've caught this earlier.
sasha: agreed. Adding alert and dashboard panel.
pranav: summary: root cause = padding-based reservation increased per-entry residency and caused slab fragmentation -> small mmaps -> OOMs on longseq tails. Action: revert canary, add feature-flagged dynamic packing, add CI longseq job, new alerts.
jen: thanks — can we get a rollback and hold on global?
deploy-bot: rollback scheduled for canary cluster (id: canary-east-2), ETA 6m.
infra-bot: bisect note: offending commit 9f8c3b7 authored by @alim; small followup CL recommended.
pranav: pinging @alim for review of the fix.
pranav: I'll post final after canary rollback completes. :thumbsup:
